title: Parking Programme Terms: The Weekly Parking Maximum on Guest Folios and the Guest's Election Tool
content:
A guest whose stay has at least the minimum nights parked may elect the weekly parking maximum for the stay, and makes the election personally. The weekly parking maximum is a limit on the parking a stay at an Ashbury hotel is charged on its Guest Folio, chosen by the guest in person.

## Conditions on the maximum

The weekly parking maximum of a stay is applied only after the self-parking lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards parking savings they are owed.

The weekly parking maximum of a stay is not worked out until the valet lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards valet savings they are owed.

## Effect of the election

The parking charged above the weekly parking maximum is taken off the parking line of the seventh night parked, with the reason that the stay's parking was charged above the applicable rate. The election covers the nights parked up to the moment it is made, and parking lines posted after it are charged as posted.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Who elects | The guest, personally |
| Which stays | A stay with at least the minimum nights parked |
| Where the excess comes off | The parking line of the seventh night parked |
| Reason recorded | The stay's parking was charged above the applicable rate |
| Nights covered | Those parked up to the moment of the election; later parking lines are charged as posted |

## The guest's tool: `elect_weekly_parking_5ade5692`

**Capability.** The guest elects, in person, the weekly parking maximum for the parking of their current stay, and the parking charged above that maximum is taken off one parking charge line of the open folio. One call books one adjustment line in the guest's own election that names that parking charge, carries its charge code and business date, is recorded with the reason that the stay's parking was charged above the applicable rate, and lowers the folio balance by the amount taken off. The guest sees the correction printed under that parking charge on the bill.

**How it is invoked.** `elect_weekly_parking_5ade5692` belongs to the guest: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `folio_id` | The reference number of the guest folio of the stay, as given by the desk | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the guest's profile, as given by the desk | Id |
| `related_posting_id` | The reference number of the parking charge line the excess is taken off, as given by the desk | Id |
| `excess_amount` | The parking charged above the weekly maximum | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; rounded half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `posting_id` (reference number of the new correction line), `folio_id`, `related_posting_id` (the parking charge corrected), `charge_code` (the corrected line's code), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the amount taken off), `balance_due` (USD to 2 decimal places, the folio balance afterwards) and `status`, which reads "elected" when the correction stands.
